description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to runtime group policy resolution and fallback policies, including functions for resolving policies based on configuration and warnings for missing policies.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeGroupPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective group policy based on provided parameters, applying fallback policies if necessary.

methods.name: resolveDefaultGroupPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the default group policy from configuration.

methods.name: resolveOpenProviderRuntimeGroupPolicy
methods.description: Resolves group policy with a standard 'open' fallback policy.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistProviderRuntimeGroupPolicy
methods.description: Resolves group policy with an 'allowlist' fallback policy.

methods.name: warnMissingProviderGroupPolicyFallbackOnce
methods.description: Logs a warning once if a provider's group policy fallback is applied.

methods.name: resetMissingProviderGroupPolicyFallbackWarningsForTesting
methods.description: Resets the warning cache for testing purposes.
